bullets.text: descaling the kettle with vinegar. the smell insists something is happening. the kettle has no comment.
duck at okunoin, clear sky after a week of grey. the line it carries is about wasted energy. the cedars waste none.
a wasp tried every window on the south side, then left the way it came in.
restless, and the line said so before i got around to it.
the kettle boils the same whether or not you stand there.
